senses.gloss: m. (preced.) plait, gathering stitch, a kind of border.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:8:4">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵈ</cite> <he>הסולם והק׳ אין וכ׳</he> the borders formed by chain stitches or by plaiting are no hindrance (for the rending of the garment in mourning), v. <cite ref="O00321"><he>סוּלָּם</he></cite>.
